ShortDescription: Great location on N. Aurora St. in Fall Creek. 10-min. walk to Ithaca Commons, 15-to-20 mins. to the Cornell Arts Quad, and easy access to buses for other areas of campus or shopping. Fully furnished room, about 200 square feet including storage for rent. Queen poster bed, dresser, bookcase, desk, and ergonomic chair. Lots of storage in two big closets. Good light from 2 large windows. There are 2 other renters in this 4-bedroom, 2-bath home. Preferably for international doctoral students, post-docs, or visiting scholars. Quiet spaces for work, study, and small gatherings of friends. After raising my children in this family home, I have rented from one-to-three bedrooms, as individual rooms with access to the full house and grounds, for most of the past 15 years. Renters have come from four continents and many countries, bringing their cultural and food traditions—Vietnam, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, the Congo, Turkey, India, Colombia, Haiti, Iran, China, and Albania. Some renters stay for 1 to 4 years; others are visiting scholars or faculty at Cornell. I continue to work from the studio space behind the house and have a room in the house, where my partner and I occasionally stay. The advantage of this relationship is that I am on-site almost every day to address questions that come up in transition and any maintenance or repairs. Use the onsite separate studio space (when available), drums, full dining room, living room, and possible shared driveway space. Enjoy the yard, including a lovely garden and decks in the front and back of the house.

ShortDescription: Welcome to the Historic Red Brick Mansion. Become a part of Ithaca’s history when you live in this building, which has been officially designated as an Ithaca Landmark. The house is now configured into five unique apartments and a large parking lot that fits 38 vehicles. Assigned Parking available for an extra fee. All apartments are fully furnished. This fabulous Collegetown location is perfect for Graduate Students—still close to Cornell, yet just outside the main commercial blocks, adding desirable privacy and quietness to an otherwise crowded neighborhood. 12 month leases. Rent includes heat & hot water and furniture.

ShortDescription: Rustic country 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home on 12 acres with access to a clean, beautiful private pond for swimming and fishing. Enjoy nature! You get country living here, but you're still very close to shopping and dining. Pet-friendly! (add'l security deposit for dogs.) Spectrum fast wi-fi included, cable-TV available. 14-minute drive to Cornell University; 7-minutes to Ithaca College; 10 minutes to downtown and Wegmans grocery store. Suitable for two or more people, extra bedroom may be used for study, playroom, etc. Huge kitchen with Bosch gas stove and Bosch dishwasher and plenty of counter space. Primary bedroom has 16-foot high ceiling with loft area; it has a queen bed, en suite full bathroom, and two walk in closets. Bedroom two has a king bed and TV with Roku; bedroom three has a queen bed; and bedroom four has a twin bed. All bedrooms have big closets, all on second floor. Tremendous full bathroom on second floor with many shelves. Several desks and dressers can be moved around as needed. Attached garage, plus plenty of room for parking in the driveway. Living room has classic wood stove (there's also conventional baseboard heat throughout house from high efficiency Buderus boiler), Roku TV, laser printer, two couches and comfy TV chair. Dining area with seating for six. Large wraparound deck with grill, dining area and country views, accessed from front and kitchen doors. Samsung washer and dryer in first floor laundry room. Lots of built-in shelving throughout. Rent shown is for 9-month lease; 12-months also available for 8% more. Ithaca School District with school bus service. Located on a great country setting that you will enjoy!
